source_checksum_scope: Recorded local SHA256 and official HTTPS origin; no publisher whole-file digest was supplied by the model card.

config.query_sampling: Same deterministic valid known-identity order statistics as original two-crop diagnostic. Actual unknown-gallery pool and independently identical unique paired keys are reported separately.
config.pair_metrics: Nearest strictly earlier same-known-fish positive and current-frame different-known-fish negatives; unknowns remain in actual gallery but are never negative labels.
config.scope: Frozen current-crop evidence only, with actual and unique paired GT/detector pools, R1/R5/mAP/AUC/EER and past gaps1/25/100. Fishpost is an exposed inherited reference; pretrained DINOv2/ImageNet have no fish fitting here, unverified external-corpus overlap. No outer-tuned representation, new-head training, old512GRU in384coordinates or native full-MOT gain/runtime claim.

discrimination.scope: Pooled known-positive/known-negative edges; repeated fish/frames are not independent samples. Diagnostic EER, no deployed threshold.
